multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Bart Millard wrote the song 'I Can Only Imagine'.
The album '10' is a greatest hits album by the band MercyMe.
'I Can Only Imagine' is included in the album '10'.
The album '10' debuted at number one on the Billboard Christian Albums chart.
The album '10' debuted at number 18 on the Billboard 200.
'I Can Only Imagine' was included on the band's major-label debut album 'Almost There'.
